body: The axe and seed bag are wrapped in checkpoint tape. A tag shows one place struck out and another in different ink. The tape edges have printed bits about moving people and records.
title: Hand axe and seed sack

body: The deer came from a pasture that had been sprayed yesterday. Its mouth was wet with a bitter smell, and its legs shook. The driver said the creek near the rows smelled the same.
title: Notepad page
